q: Where must access control be applied in production RAG?
options: At retrieval time, before passages reach the model
explain: Anything the model sees can leak into the answer.

q: What is the most common gap when a source document is deleted?
options: Chunks or cached answers that cited it remain in indexes and caches
explain: Deletion must propagate to every index and cache.

q: Which failure point means the right passage exists but ranks too low?
explain: Fix with hybrid search, reranking and better chunking.
